run_preprocess_mention_dicts: run the script to preprocess Wikipedia mention dictionaries for multiple languages into pickle files
build_mention_to_wikidata_mapping: build a mapping from normalized Wikipedia mentions to Wikidata IDs across multiple language editions
create_wikidata_language_priority: create a priority ranking of languages for each Wikidata ID based on mention frequency
normalize_chinese_mentions: normalize Chinese mentions to simplified form and apply Unicode NFKD normalization with bullet replacement
extract_wikipedia_abstract_mentions: extract mention-to-Wikidata mappings from Wikipedia article abstracts only using the abstracts flag
